_comment: zones.json - every zone the world has (Scripts/zone_info.gd). 'scene' is the zone scene; 'port_offset' is added to the login server's port (8910 live, so Dustwind listens on 8920): each zone runs as its own server process on that port (tools/run_world.sh starts them all). The default zone is where new characters start and the login server runs it. A zone line (Scripts/zone_line.gd) names its target zone and the Marker3D (under Markers) you arrive at.
